texts.NIV84: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.
texts.KJV: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
texts.NKJV:
A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches,
Loving favor rather than silver and gold.
texts.DRB: A good name is better than great riches: and good favour is above silver and gold.

texts.NIV84: Rich and poor have this in common: The LORD is the Maker of them all.
texts.KJV: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.
texts.NKJV:
The rich and the poor have this in common,
The Lord is the maker of them all.
texts.DRB: The rich and poor have met one another: the Lord is the maker of them both.

texts.NIV84: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge, but the simple keep going and suffer for it.
texts.KJV: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
texts.NKJV:
A prudent man foresees evil and hides himself,
But the simple pass on and are punished.
texts.DRB: The prudent man saw the evil, and hid himself: the simple passed on, and suffered loss.

texts.NIV84: Humility and the fear of the LORD bring wealth and honor and life.
texts.KJV: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.
texts.NKJV:
By humility and the fear of the Lord
Are riches and honor and life.
texts.DRB: The fruit of humility is the fear of the Lord, riches and glory and life.

texts.NIV84: In the paths of the wicked lie thorns and snares, but he who guards his soul stays far from them.
texts.KJV: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
texts.NKJV:
Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse;
He who guards his soul will be far from them.
texts.DRB: Arms and swords are in the way of the perverse: but he that keepeth his own soul departeth far from them.

texts.NIV84: Train a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not turn from it.
texts.KJV: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
texts.NKJV:
Train up a child in the way he should go,
And when he is old he will not depart from it.
texts.DRB: It is a proverb: A young man according to his way, even when he is old he will not depart from it.

blocks.title: He Who Has a Generous Eye

texts.NIV84: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
texts.KJV: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
texts.NKJV:
The rich rules over the poor,
And the borrower is servant to the lender.
texts.DRB: The rich ruleth over the poor: and the borrower is servant to him that lendeth.

texts.NIV84: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
texts.KJV: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
texts.NKJV:
He who sows iniquity will reap sorrow,
And the rod of his anger will fail.
texts.DRB: He that soweth iniquity shall reap evils, and with the rod of his anger he shall be consumed.

texts.NIV84: A generous man will himself be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
texts.KJV: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
texts.NKJV:
He who has a generous eye will be blessed,
For he gives of his bread to the poor.
texts.DRB: He that is inclined to mercy shall be blessed: for of his bread he hath given to the poor. He that maketh presents shall purchase victory and honour: but he carrieth away the souls of the receivers.

blocks.title: He Who Loves Purity of Heart

texts.NIV84: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.
texts.KJV: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
texts.NKJV:
Cast out the scoffer, and contention will leave;
Yes, strife and reproach will cease.
texts.DRB: Cast out the scoffer, and contention shall go out with him, and quarrels and reproaches shall cease.

texts.NIV84: He who loves a pure heart and whose speech is gracious will have the king for his friend.
texts.KJV: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
texts.NKJV:
He who loves purity of heart
And has grace on his lips,
The king will be his friend.
texts.DRB: He that loveth cleanness of heart, for the grace of his lips shall have the king for his friend.

texts.NIV84: The eyes of the LORD keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
texts.KJV: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
texts.NKJV:
The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge,
But He overthrows the words of the faithless.
texts.DRB: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge: and the words of the unjust are overthrown.

texts.NIV84: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside!" or, "I will be murdered in the streets!"
texts.KJV: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
texts.NKJV:
The lazy man says, “There is a lion outside!
I shall be slain in the streets!”
texts.DRB: The slothful man saith: There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the midst of the streets.

texts.NIV84: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the LORD's wrath will fall into it.
texts.KJV: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.
texts.NKJV:
The mouth of an immoral woman is a deep pit;
He who is abhorred by the Lord will fall there.
texts.DRB: The mouth of a strange woman is a deep pit: he whom the Lord is angry with, shall fall into it.

texts.NIV84: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far from him.
texts.KJV: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
texts.NKJV:
Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child;
The rod of correction will drive it far from him.
texts.DRB: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, and the rod of correction shall drive it away.

texts.NIV84: He who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and he who gives gifts to the rich-both come to poverty.
texts.KJV: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
texts.NKJV:
He who oppresses the poor to increase his riches,
And he who gives to the rich, will surely come to poverty.
texts.DRB: He that oppresseth the poor, to in- crease his own riches, shall himself give to one that is richer, and shall be in need.

blocks.title: Incline Your Ear & Apply Your Heart

texts.NIV84: Pay attention and listen to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,
texts.KJV: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise,
And apply your heart to my knowledge;
texts.DRB: Incline thy ear, and hear the words of the wise: and apply thy heart to my doctrine :

texts.NIV84: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.
texts.KJV: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
texts.NKJV:
For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you;
Let them all be fixed upon your lips,
texts.DRB: Which shall be beautiful for thee, if thou keep it in thy bowels, and it shall flow in thy lips:

texts.NIV84: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I teach you today, even you.
texts.KJV: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
texts.NKJV:
So that your trust may be in the Lord;
I have instructed you today, even you.
texts.DRB: That thy trust may be in the Lord, wherefore I have also shewn it to thee this day.

texts.NIV84: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,
texts.KJV: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
texts.NKJV:
Have I not written to you excellent things
Of counsels and knowledge,
texts.DRB: Behold I have described it to thee three manner of ways, in thoughts and knowledge :

texts.NIV84: teaching you true and reliable words, so that you can give sound answers to him who sent you?
texts.KJV: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
texts.NKJV:
That I may make you know the certainty of the words of truth,
That you may answer words of truth
To those who send to you?
texts.DRB: That I might shew thee the certainty, and the words of truth, to answer out of these to them that sent thee.

blocks.title: No Friendship With an Angry Man

texts.NIV84: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,
texts.KJV: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
texts.NKJV:
Do not rob the poor because he is poor,
Nor oppress the afflicted at the gate;
texts.DRB: Do no violence to the poor, because he is poor: and do not oppress the needy in the gate:

texts.NIV84: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who plunder them.
texts.KJV: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
texts.NKJV:
For the Lord will plead their cause,
And plunder the soul of those who plunder them.
texts.DRB: Because the Lord will judge his cause, and will afflict them that have afflicted his soul.

texts.NIV84: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered man, do not associate with one easily angered,
texts.KJV: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
texts.NKJV:
Make no friendship with an angry man,
And with a furious man do not go,
texts.DRB: Be not a friend to an angry man, and do not walk with a furious man:

texts.NIV84: or you may learn his ways and get yourself ensnared.
texts.KJV: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
texts.NKJV:
Lest you learn his ways
And set a snare for your soul.
texts.DRB: Lest perhaps thou learn his ways, and take scandal to thy soul.

blocks.title: A Man Who Excels in His Work

texts.NIV84: Do not be a man who strikes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;
texts.KJV: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
texts.NKJV:
Do not be one of those who shakes hands in a pledge,
One of those who is surety for debts;
texts.DRB: Be not with them that fasten down their hands, and that offer themselves sureties for debts:

texts.NIV84: if you lack the means to pay, your very bed will be snatched from under you.
texts.KJV: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
texts.NKJV:
If you have nothing with which to pay,
Why should he take away your bed from under you?
texts.DRB: For if thou have not wherewith to restore, what cause is there, that he should take the covering from thy bed?

texts.NIV84: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your forefathers.
texts.KJV: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
texts.NKJV:
Do not remove the ancient landmark
Which your fathers have set.
texts.DRB: Pass not beyond the ancient bounds which thy fathers have set.

texts.NIV84: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve before kings; he will not serve before obscure men.
texts.KJV: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
texts.DRB: Hast thou seen a man swift in his work? he shall stand before kings, and shall not be before those that are obscure.
